subject: Capacity certification & handshake for Hosted→Dedicated migration
messages:
From: Priya Sharma <psharma@stellarnet.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Lee <sam.lee@stellarnet.io>
Date: Tue, 29 Aug 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted→Dedicated: capacity certification request and timeline

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the productive call today. We're ready to move forward with Redwood Dedicated for our core inference path (user-facing chat + search rerank). Per procurement, they need a short note confirming the capacity numbers + an engineer-facing validation window we can coordinate with our infra team.

Attached is the accepted capacity matrix from legal (accepted_capacity_matrix.xlsx) that shows the committed Q4 throughput profile. High-level:
- 2x p100-equivalent GPU pools for chat (steady),
- burst up to 4x for scheduled batch reranks,
- target p95 latency <= 180ms for chat under committed QPS.

Can you outline the minimal validation runs and a proposed handoff/cutover timeline so we can schedule DocuSign and procurement approvals? We want to avoid a long blackout for our product launch on 2028-10-02.

Thanks,
Priya Sharma
Head of Platform Engineering
StellarNet

Attachment: accepted_capacity_matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet, 1 sheet)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Sharma <psharma@stellarnet.io>
Cc: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted→Dedicated: capacity certification request and timeline

Hi Priya — appreciate the matrix. Congrats to the StellarNet team on getting this far.

Summary of what we need to certify + proposed plan (high level):
1) Preflight artifacts (what we need from you):
   - 24h trace of production traffic (anonymized) + token distribution for chat vs rerank
   - SLO targets (p50/p95/p99) and a representative prompt set (we'll use this for regression checks)
2) Validation runs (what Redwood will do):
   - Baseline smoke: single-GPU functional validation 
   - Throughput sweep: simulated QPS at committed rates (3 runs over 48h)
   - Canary stress: live traffic shadowing for 6 hours with KV/prefix caching enabled
   - Regression eval: compare generation quality on prompt set (automated eval + one human spot-check)
3) Gating criteria (pass/fail):
   - p95 latency at or below 180ms in steady-state throughput sweep
   - <2% token-error/decoding anomalies vs hosted baseline
   - No categorical regressions on 5 core prompt categories (intent, slot-filling, summarization, rerank precision)

Proposed timeline (tight):
- Week 1 (patch window): you share traces and prompts (by 2028-09-04)
- Week 2: Redwood runs baseline + throughput sweep (2028-09-06 → 2028-09-10)
- Week 3: Canary shadow and regression eval (2028-09-13)
- Week 4: Cutover rehearsal & go/no-go (2028-09-18)

We attach a short checklist for migration inputs (migration-reqs-checklist.pdf). If you sign off on this plan we can lock in engineer-day allocations and schedule the rehearsal on 9/18; that keeps you clear for an operational cutover the week of 2028-09-25 and full production by 2028-10-02.

CC'ing Monica (solutions) and Aditya (infra ops) who will own the runs.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: migration-reqs-checklist.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <psharma@stellarnet.io>
Date: Mon, 11 Sep 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Internal: StellarNet validation runs — scheduling and gating

Team — moving this into ops planning. Priya accepted the high-level plan but asked for short windows to avoid product blackout. Action items: 

- Monica: lead regression evals and human spot-checks. Use the provided prompt set; ensure eval harness includes rerank precision metrics. Plan: 9/06 smoke, 9/07-9/09 throughput sweep, 9/13 canary.
- Aditya: allocate two dedicated GPU nodes for the sweep (QPS simulation). Coordinate KV cache priming and model quantization profile (we should match hosted quantization). Confirm drift-tolerance settings.
- Karthik: confirm access to traces and DocuSign timeline with Priya (do this by EOD 9/12).

Gating criteria reiterated:
A) p95 <= 180ms for steady workload (90th percentile of sweep windows)
B) no more than 2% token decoding anomalies over 24h aggregate
C) regression eval delta <= 1.5% for rerank precision on the provided testset

If all gates pass in the rehearsal on 9/18 we do a controlled cutover schedule the week of 9/25 with a 4-hour rollback window each day for three days. If anything fails, escalate to eng on-call and delay.

Note: attach a small CSV stub we will use to record run outputs (validation-run-results-stub.csv).

Thanks — please reply with confirmation of node assignments and who will join the 9/18 rehearsal call.

-K

Attachment: validation-run-results-stub.csv (CSV stub, header only)

From: Priya Sharma <psharma@stellarnet.io>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samuel Lee <sam.lee@stellarnet.io>, monica_patel <monica@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Capacity certification & handshake for Hosted→Dedicated migration

Karthik / team — thanks for the clear plan and checklist. We reviewed with procurement and SRE; procurement will sign the agreement once we have a confirmed rehearsal window on 9/18 and a short note from Redwood certifying the capacity profile after the rehearsal.

Confirmations:
- Traces and prompt set uploaded to our secure S3 (link shared via separate email to your team).
- SRE will allocate two test slaves for the sweep and will be on the call 9/13 and 9/18.
- DocuSign routing has been created (HubSpot deal 3417). Procurement asked that a single-sentence attestation be provided after the 9/18 rehearsal covering: whether the committed p95 and decoding stability gates were met.

Please send the attestation (short email) immediately after the rehearsal; we will treat that as the technical signoff to kick procurement. If rehearsal is successful, we will schedule the 9/25 controlled cutover window.

Thanks — looking forward to the 9/13 canary and 9/18 rehearsal.

—Priya
Head of Platform Engineering, StellarNet
